principles.name: Tralse Success Distinction
principles.statement: TSD-A (additive per-event TIU over successes) is the correct metric for high-intentionality-per-event regimes; TSD-B (conventional success-vs-failure rate) is the correct metric for high-N-low-intentionality regimes.

falsifiers.evidence: breathwork-revelation self-example + 4-pronged ESP straw-man composite ruling
Pass-59 Bengston: high TSD-A registers, TSD-B also high — both metrics concur

principles.ratification_readiness: READY — strong worked examples; no falsifier tripped

principles.name: Active-Pragmatism Principle
principles.statement: Inference frameworks require ≥2 of 3 active-engagement criteria (intentional engagement, stakes/consequence, skill/discipline asymmetry) to be credited as confirming an intentionality-mediated outcome.

falsifiers.evidence: 10/12 simulation cells beat conventional; mean ΔAUC +0.042
Pass-58 TSS-EMP-5 medical-RCT negative control: M-C does not artifactually win where engagement absent

principles.ratification_readiness: READY — sim + negative control both pass

principles.name: Confirmation-Sufficiency Refinement
principles.statement: TSIS four-gate stack confirmation requires structural pass on all gates; partial pass (≤2/4) is structurally INDETERMINATE regardless of conventional p-value.

falsifiers.evidence: Pass-58 batch-1 corpus re-eval: PEAR/GCP correctly retracted, Ganzfeld/Radin correctly retained

principles.name: Model-Belief-Evidence Accumulation Coherence
principles.statement: A confirmation procedure must show coherent posterior-evidence accumulation tracking ground truth across the experimental tape — pure noise cannot fake coherent accumulation.

falsifiers.evidence: ECE M-C 0.0196 vs M-A 0.0235 vs M-B 0.0413 — TSIS calibration superior

principles.name: TSIS Four-Gate Inference Stack
principles.statement: Canonical inference stack = TSD-A coherent ∧ LCC ≥ 0.4370 ∧ effect ≥ T_RAND = 0.0660 ∧ MBE-Acc coherent. Replaces binary p<0.05 NHST as the canonical confirmation procedure.

falsifiers.evidence: Pass-58 TSS-MATH-4: 0/N at N=100k under null; absolute thresholds structurally N-invariant
Pass-58 re-eval: Ganzfeld, Radin, Bengston correctly retained

principles.name: Moot-Failure Duality (dual-axis)
principles.statement: Epistemic verdict and pragmatic verdict are separable axes. An effect can be epistemic-CONFIRM-likely while pragmatic-Moot (awaiting independent replication, or methodology open). The two axes do not collapse into a single boolean.

falsifiers.evidence: Pass-58 TSS-EMP-3 utility-sweep: MFD-1 celebrate-rate utility-responsive (0.907→0.987 under signal)
Pass-58 TSS-EMP-5: negative control confirms MFD-1 does NOT artifactually win in engagement-absent domain

principles.statement: For physiological-only-engagement paradigms (presentiment), reduce APP-1 to ≥1 of 3 criteria, with compensatory effect-strength gate raised to T_BORDER = 0.13534.

principles.name: Reverse-Osmosis Statistical-Significance
principles.statement: Confirmation procedures must operate as active separation under applied pressure against a noise-concentration gradient. Equivalently: thresholds must be N-invariant absolute values.
